# möbius for macOS 0.17.16

Transcript movement is smoother when you send a message, read a reply, or expand its details.

- Replies and expandable transcript details animate more smoothly.
- Choose **Follow** or **Glide to top** in Settings. Glide anchors your new message near the top.
- Sending from another window or device leaves your scroll position alone.

Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This app bundles gateway 0.17.15 and uses protocol 105. If you’re upgrading from an older gateway, check the [0.17.15 gateway upgrade notes](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/releases/tag/mobius-gateway-v0.17.15).
